title: Matveev-Beal Level 26: Rank-3 Bugeaud-Laurent shape nogo
description: Tag v24-v24x-final-rank3-shape-nogo on foundations-level-26 (GitHub slug beal-level-26-foundations, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22379293). C1_floor=143186215390. B0_nat=1000000. Separate Lake target BealMatveevBealV25Rank3 wraps the shipped rank-3 lattice of MatveevLLL.lean: v = 4 b1 − 13 b2 encodes Lambda = 4 log A − 13 log(B+3); on a gap-3 solution with B > B0 one has ‖v‖ < 32 (a short vector, not a B ≤ B0 cutoff). Theorems: gap3_B_lt_A_of_sol (B < A), abs_Lambda_lt_inv_B (|Lambda| < 1/B), lll_short_vector_of_large_B, future_unconditional_shape (by_cases implication). LLL_reduces_bound_to_B0 / hGen / hLLL stay uninhabited def Prop. Does not claim Euclidean length ≥ B0 or |u α + v| > exp(−B0) (those are lll_euclidean_lower_bound_fails and lll_form_lower_bound_fails). Does not import MatveevThm14General from the Rank-3 root module. Default lake build BealMatveevBeal stays 0 sorry and does not glob the Rank-3 file. Does not mint v25.0.0-Beal-44-13-Level-26-Baker-B0-Unconditional-foundations. Prior v24.4.0 version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22732209. Series concept 10.5281/zenodo.22379293.
